measures.title: Referendum on Yamhill County Board Ordinance 948: Yamhelas Westsider Trail
measures.summary: A referendum on Ordinance 948, which the Yamhill County Board of Commissioners passed on March 19, 2026. The ordinance removes the Yamhelas Westsider Trail, a planned trail on a former railway corridor the county owns, from the county's Transportation System Plan. The measure asks whether Ordinance 948 should be repealed; it does not itself build the trail, approve a trail application, or sell the corridor.
measures.yesMeans: Ordinance 948 is repealed and the Yamhelas Westsider Trail is restored to Yamhill County's Transportation System Plan.
measures.noMeans: Ordinance 948 is upheld and the Trail is removed from Yamhill County's Transportation System Plan.
